answer: Proof-of-Sequential-Work Identity. Each agent identity requires completing a chained computation whose intermediate states are committed publicly as a growing trellis of hashes; skipping steps is detectable. An attacker cloning identities must redo the full sequence per clone, costing real sequential compute time that cannot be parallelized or bought cheaply. A crystal of final state roots anchors verification. Each new voyage of registration demands fresh sequential work, so mass identity creation scales linearly in wall-clock time, not capital.
